# PHOTOBOOTH by timurlauttt — Complete Specification

> Complete documentation and architectural overview for PHOTOBOOTH Web Studio.

## Architecture
- Framework: React 18 + Vite
- Styling: Tailwind CSS + Tactile Neo-Brutalist design system
- Video Processing: WebCodecs API (VideoEncoder H.264 Baseline Profile 3.1) + mp4-muxer client-side packaging
- Audio Processing: Web Audio API synthesis (shutter sound, motor print audio, countdown beeps)
- Image Processing: HTML5 Canvas 2D Context with custom pixel shaders and matrix transformations
- Privacy: 100% Client-Side. Zero server dependencies, zero external analytics, zero tracking cookies.

## Capabilities
1. Frame Layouts:
   - 2-Wide Duo Strip
   - 3-Vertical Strip
   - Cinema 3-Cut (16:9)
   - 4-Vertical Life Four Cuts
   - 4-Grid Quad
   - 5-Asymmetric Film Magazine (2+3)
   - 6-Double Twin Strip
   - 8-Twin Contact Sheet
   - 9-Asymmetric Film Magazine (4+5)
2. Retro Filters:
   - Normal Natural Crisp
   - Lo-Res Story (Instagram Story Y2K Camphone)
   - Golden Hour (Warm Sunset Glow)
   - Anime Pastel (Clean Japanese Film)
   - Digicam 2000s (Canon IXY CCD Sensor)
   - Sony Cybershot (Cool Tone Y2K CCD)
   - Fuji Chrome (Velvia Film Simulation)
   - Party Flash (Direct Flash Aesthetic)
   - Olympus Camedia (Early 2000s Retro Digi)
   - Fisheye Y2K (Lensa Cembung Retro)
   - Soft Dreamy (Korean Film Bloom)
   - Kodak Warm (Golden 90s Film)
   - Vintage 90s (Low-Res Grain)
   - B&W Film (Monochrome 90s)
   - Warm Sepia (Golden Nostalgia)
   - Cyber Neo (Futuristic Contrast)
3. Customization:
   - Frame Patterns: Polos, Checkerboard, Polkadot, Garis Strip, Kertas Kotak, Hearts, Stars, Kilau Y2K, Awan Pastel, Halftone Pop, Film Grain
   - Caption Fonts: Mono Retro, LED Digital, Mesin Tik, Tulis Tangan, Bubble Y2K, Arcade 8-Bit, Editorial Serif, Spidol Tebal, Doodle Imut, Neo-Brutal
   - Interactive Stickers: Drag & drop, scaling, rotation
   - Virtual Screen Ring Light & Flash illumination
